sentence: Among high-tech ventures, revenue reacts only once adoption passes a sufficient intensity, and the gains grow where the venture also runs complementary technologies, cloud services and databases among them, and keeps its R&D strategy internal
passage: [Lee et al. (2022), p. 1] "We find that firm revenue increases only after sufficient investment in AI, and the benefits of AI adoption are greater at firms that also invest in complementary technologies and pursue internal R&D strategy." / "We find that such performance gains from adoption is larger among firms that invest in complementary technologies such as cloud computing and database systems."

gemini.note: The passage discusses firms in general and specifically investment in AI, whereas the sentence unjustifiably restricts the finding to high-tech ventures.
